$comment: Maturity: v1alpha1, may break with a changelog entry in api/README.md (ADR 0027). Versioned but internal: not promised to outsiders until a second agent implementation exists (ADR 0020 and ADR 0025 amendments). ADRs: 0020, 0021, 0045, 0048.
title: Rangelight agent event v1alpha1
description: One typed message from a lane's agent to Rangelight. The rld sidecar validates every outgoing message against this schema and its size caps before it publishes it; the model can say only what the schema allows (ADR 0045 §2 and §5). Free text to other lanes doesn't exist.

messageId.description: Client event id, the idempotency key: receivers dedupe on it (ADR 0021, ADR 0045 §2).

sessionId.description: The lane's session. rld sets it from its own credential; the agent can't choose it.

at.description: When the agent emitted the event.

ask.description: The lane needs a member: it moves to waiting_for_you, and the dispatcher and the lane's owner see it (ADR 0045 §2).

options.description: Optional choices to offer the member.

workerDone.description: The agent says it is done. This starts Rangelight's own checks on the pushed head; the summary is a claim, never proof (ADR 0045 §3).

headSha.description: The commit the agent pushed and wants checked.

progress.description: Feed only (ADR 0045 §2), except that it ends a wait for the member: the lane went on. The agent sends one with stage 'turn' at each turn start (RAN-63).

compacted.description: The agent session's context was compacted. The PreCompact hook persists the summary, so the receipt records that compaction happened (ADR 0020).
